decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The external roof materials to be used for the extension hereby permitted shall match those used on the existing building, and samples of the brick to be used for the external walls shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced and only the brick as approved shall be used.
Condition : 3 - No additional door or window openings shall be provided in the external walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the rear extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house.
